task: Remove legacy single-slot UI and add per-archive confirmed deletion
changes: Removed the old single-slot save/restore controls and their frontend control operations; retained new game, sync, reset, and multi-moment saves.
Only archive-kind entries are placed in the visible list. Each archive has 44px read/delete controls.

Delete requires a native accessible confirmation naming the archive and stating deletion is irreversible and does not affect current progress. Cancel, Escape, and close clear targets without issuing a request.

Delete uses POST with the existing session header and VersionRequest fields. Success refreshes the save list without changing local drafts; uncertain network outcomes use the existing state/list reconciliation without replaying the delete. SAVE_NOT_FOUND refreshes the list and leaves the server error visible.
Session/generation changes clear pending targets. Save, read, and delete remain available in playing and won states.
